# External Image Corpus Licensing

The root MIT License does not apply to samples in this directory unless a sample's provenance record
explicitly says otherwise. These files exercise external codec behavior and are not included in
QuickLook Next release packages.

Before adding or redistributing a sample, record its source, author or copyright holder, license, and
required notice in `manifest.json`. Existing samples need owner provenance confirmation before they
may be redistributed outside this repository.
